tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Brandenburg Gate: * Start the day at one of Europe's most iconic landmarks — huge, historic, photogenic. → | 🏢 Reichstag (Glass Dome): * A modern dome with a cool spiral walkway and panoramic city views. Advance time slots recommended, but super memorable. → | 🕊️ Holocaust Memorial: * A quiet, reflective maze of concrete blocks creating a moving, respectful atmosphere. → | ☕ Coffee at Potsdamer Platz: * Modern architecture + morning break = perfect combo.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Brandenburg Gate: * Begin your day at one of Europe's most powerful historic symbols — massive columns, dramatic architecture and a lively city atmosphere all in one place. → | 🏢 Reichstag (Glass Dome): * Head up to the futuristic glass dome with its spiraling walkway and panoramic 360° views of Berlin. It’s architectural, modern and unforgettable — visiting with a booked time slot is ideal. → | 🕊️ Holocaust Memorial: * Walk through the quiet field of concrete stelae — a reflective, respectful space that encourages calm thought and remembrance. → | ☕ Coffee at Potsdamer Platz: * Take a break in Berlin’s ultra-modern district full of sharp angles, glass towers and a clean, early-day city vibe.; Afternoon: 🎨 East Side Gallery: * Explore the world’s longest open-air art gallery — the former Berlin Wall turned into a vibrant timeline of murals, messages and creativity. → | 🧱 Berlin Wall Museum (East Side): * Clear, well-presented exhibits explaining the history of the divide in an accessible, youth-friendly way — easy to follow and full of context. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Berlin Specialties: * Try classic comfort foods like currywurst (mild versions available), soft pretzels, veggie döner, potato dishes or light street-food options — Berlin’s casual, modern cuisine. → | 🏙️ Alexanderplatz: * A lively square with shops, modern façades, street performers and views of the famous TV Tower skyline.; Sunset: 🌅 Museum Island Riverside or Oberbaum Bridge: * Enjoy soft evening light reflecting on the Spree River, peaceful walkways, bridges, and golden tones perfect for atmospheric photos.; Night: 🌃 Kreuzberg Evening: * Relax in youth-friendly cafés, creative spaces, live-music corners and street-food courts. Plenty of non-alcoholic drinks like lemonades, iced teas, smoothies and mocktails — safe, energetic and fun for a cozy Berlin night.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Zwinger Palace: * Begin your day in one of Europe’s finest Baroque complexes — grand courtyards, sculpted fountains, ornate façades and beautifully arranged galleries. → | 🎨 Old Masters Gallery: * Admire masterpieces including Raphael’s ‘Sistine Madonna’ and works by Rembrandt, Vermeer and Titian — a highlight of European art. → | 🎭 Theaterplatz Walk: * Stroll through one of Dresden’s most iconic squares framed by the Semperoper, Hofkirche and other elegant buildings — pure classical scenery. → | ☕ Coffee near Semperoper: * Enjoy a relaxed drink on an elegant square with historic architecture all around.; Afternoon: ⛪ Frauenkirche: * Visit the breathtaking church rebuilt stone-by-stone after WWII — a powerful symbol of resilience and peace. → | 🌉 Brühl’s Terrace (‘Balcony of Europe’): * Walk along the elevated riverside promenade with sweeping views over the Elbe River — scenic, peaceful and perfect for photos. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Saxon Specialties: * Try hearty regional dishes and finish with the famous Dresdner Eierschecke — a soft layered cake beloved by locals.; Sunset: 🌅 Elbe River Sunset or Augustus Bridge Viewpoint: * Watch golden reflections ripple across the river with Dresden’s skyline glowing in warm evening light — a truly postcard-perfect moment.; Night: 🌃 Neustadt Creative District or Riverside Night Walk: * Explore colorful, artsy streets full of relaxed cafés, dessert spots and youth-friendly vibes — or enjoy a calm nighttime walk along the Elbe for a peaceful finish to the day.
